newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to edge up towards 100.20,25 zone.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to edge up towards 100.20,25 zone.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will head towards the 100.20,25 area on Tuesday having pushed through initial resistance around 100.05 in early trade, analysts said.
"On the upside, there's good resistance at 100.05," Dirk Aufderheide, broker at Deutsche Bank Futures and Options in Frankfurt, said.
He said that level had previously been good support before the market broke to the downside.
"If that should be broken, the next important point is the 100.00 to 100.25 area," he said.
Bunds were quoted at 100.14 at 0648 GMT, up 0.22.
